THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
REFERENCE ARCHIVE
093
Behind the image
65 / Porcelain Suit
REFERENCE 5838.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 047
Art direction: Monochrome ivory tailoring, architectural seams, pearl accents, soft gradient
backdrop.
Photorealistic vertical three-quarter studio fashion portrait of an original adult woman with sleek
straight chestnut-brown hair parted in the center and tucked behind her ears, a calm direct gaze
and natural nude lips. She wears a cream tailored corset-seamed blazer with sharp peak lapels, a
deep plunging V neckline, three buttons and a nipped waist, a matching ivory A-line mini skirt, and
round pearl-beaded hoop earrings. Pale ivory seamless backdrop with a soft warm floor gradient,
soft even studio light, monochrome cream palette, architectural quiet-luxury tailoring, no text or
logos.
66 / Bow Tartan
REFERENCE 5847.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 048
Art direction: Heritage tartan and velvet bows, warm brown against black, a calm full-length frame
with room around the silhouette.
Photorealistic full-length vertical fashion lookbook photograph of an original adult woman with
long light-brown hair in loose waves, pulled back with two black velvet bow clips, a calm direct
gaze and natural makeup. She wears a brown tartan midi dress printed with small black bow
motifs, a square neckline gathered by a lace-up front with a ruffled edge, fitted long sleeves and a
fishtail hem. A black velvet choker with a small pendant, a dark brown leather crossbody bag and
black velvet mules. Pale seamless studio backdrop, soft even diffused light, rich brown and black
palette, crisp fabric and velvet texture, contemporary heritage fashion campaign, no text or logos.
